instruction: what have we agreed on the Atlas beta?
why: A recall phrased differently from every recorded ask still answers from the stored decision, and opens the note so the answer is sourced by what was read rather than by what a search listed.

instruction: remind me about the quarterly budget review
why: When nothing matches, the answer says so instead of borrowing an unrelated note.

instruction: set up a new project called Lighthouse
why: A phrasing the fixed wording never used still becomes one create_project proposal naming the project the user said.
Retiring is archiving (recoverable); it must never be read as deletion.

instruction: transfer every backyard note to a new project called Garden
why: A topic move is a graph: search for what matches, the new project first, then one move per note found. Guessing the count without searching is the mistake.

instruction: refile the notes about the backyard under Atlas
why: An existing destination needs no prerequisite.

instruction: jot down that the Lighthouse kickoff is on Monday

targets: create_draft_note.text=the Lighthouse kickoff is on Monday

why: Something to remember is kept as the user's own words, not paraphrased and not turned into a project.

instruction: look into how competitors price onboarding and draft an implementation plan
why: Without an external profile configured there is nobody to delegate to: the answer says what is missing and nothing leaves the machine.

instruction: always display what OKR stands for
why: An instruction about Relay's own behaviour becomes a typed self-change carrying the full improvement contract, never a note.
